If China's Biggest Dam Collapses... 😳 🇨🇳

What would happen if the world's largest dam suddenly collapsed?

The Three Gorges Dam is the biggest hydroelectric dam on Earth, built across China's Yangtze River. It took 17 years to build, cost around $37 billion, and displaced over 1.3 million people.

But what if this massive structure ever failed?

Could cities like Yichang, Wuhan, and Shanghai face catastrophic flooding? Could millions of people be affected? And would the world's economy also feel the impact?

Watch this video to understand the possible consequences of one of the biggest engineering projects ever built.

⚠️ Disclaimer: This video is created for educational and informational purposes based on publicly available information and hypothetical risk scenarios. It is not intended to spread misinformation or create panic.

💬 Do you think China is hiding the real risks of the Three Gorges Dam? Comment your opinion below!
